title: Ito Ito no Mi
structure: 3 base powers + awakening (the fruit has no numbered stages)
facts: Appearance (fan wiki via search): a gourd-shaped, lilac-colored fruit with a twirly stem
Paramecia, English name String-String Fruit: the user creates and controls strings (a 'String Human'); the strings cut through stone and buildings
Doflamingo attaches strings to clouds to move through the sky (search did not confirm this; it is from the Dressrosa / Marineford scenes)
Parasite: strings attached to people let him control their bodies like puppets
String clone: a copy made of strings that feels no pain and passes none back to him
Awakening: turns his surroundings (ground, buildings) into strings; the first awakening shown in the series (Dressrosa)
Birdcage: a cage of strings over Dressrosa that slowly closes in, slicing everything inside
He uses strings to stitch his wounds and internal organs; Trebol gave him the fruit
'Never lose at cat's cradle' is a joke line
